subject: Mac Pro 3,1 Early 2008 chassis guide: SSD relocation to free 4 bays for 4x1TB HDD + AMD GPU swap

facts.claim: Target is Mac Pro 3,1 Early 2008, 2x Quad Xeon 2.8GHz, BootROM MP31.006C.B05, Lion 10.7 on Bay 1 Lion SSD Base.

source.quote: Mac Pro 3,1 Early 2008; operator confirmed 2026-09-12 with photo (chat attachment): 'it is a 3,1 early 2008'

facts.claim: Four independent 3Gb/s SATA cable-free direct-attach bays, numbered 1 bottom to 4 top in chassis photo, with captive sleds.

source.ref: Apple Mac Pro Early 2008 tech specs + operator photo 2026-09-12
source.quote: Four independent 3Gb/s Serial ATA cable-free bays

facts.claim: Two spare SATA II 3Gb/s ports on logic board behind fan assembly under Bay 1, unused in stock 3,1, routable to optical bays.

source.ref: docs/macpro-storage-facts.json F-04 + blog.greggant Definitive Mac Pro Upgrade Guide
source.quote: two unused SATA ports located in the upper left corner behind fan assembly

facts.claim: Optical bays on Mac Pro 1,1-3,1 are PATA/ATA-100 with 4-pin Molex power; SATA SSD needs Molex->SATA power adapter and data from hidden SATA.

source.quote: ATA/IDE cabling in the Optical bays, with 4-pin molex power connectors

facts.claim: 2.5in SATA SSD can be mounted in lower optical bay with 2.5->5.25 adapter bracket, bootable via hidden SATA, freeing all 4 bays for 3.5in HDDs.

source.quote: install two SATA drives in the Optical bay with the Optical drive

facts.claim: Installed GPU is EVGA GTX 285 requiring two 6-pin PCIe power leads; photo shows both unplugged and dangling, must reconnect before boot.

source.quote: GTX 285, both 6-pin power leads

facts.claim: Blue-shroud card on desk is AMD ATI GPU (alternative to GTX 285), needs digital cable (DVI/HDMI/DP) not VGA-HDMI converter, Mac-EFI required for boot screens.

source.ref: ToDo.md step 0 display decision + operator photo
source.quote: AMD card + digital cable, Mac-EFI or no boot screens

facts.claim: 4x WD Caviar Green 1TB WD10EACS-00D6B0, SATA 3Gb/s 16MB cache, desktop Green with IntelliPark 8s head park, no TLER, mitigation wdidle3/idle3-tools.

source.quote: WD Caviar Green 1.0TB WD10EACS-00D6B0

facts.claim: CR2032 dead, clock resets to 2001-01-01 on power loss, fix with sudo date MMDDhhmmYY after any power-off, do NOT set 2015/2016.

source.quote: CR2032 dead, resets to 2001

facts.claim: Force-off at idle blind login is journal-safe; Mac must be powered off for chassis work; lower PCI bracket screw is captive preload, do not force.

source.quote: force-off at idle blind login is journal-safe

facts.claim: GTX 285 Mac Edition has 2x dual-link DVI max 2560x1600; passive DVI->HDMI is single-link 1920x1200 ceiling, 1440p+ blinds machine with no auto-revert, 1080p ceiling on VGA chain.

source.quote: Select 1440p or higher on the VGA-HDMI chain (1080p ceiling)

facts.claim: AppleRAID software supports stripe/mirror/concat only, no RAID 5; RAID 5 in factory bays requires hardware RAID card + MaxConnect SAS/SATA breakout cable.
facts.value: AppleRAID no RAID5, needs HBA + cable

source.quote: AppleRAID supports three basic types: stripe, mirror, concat

facts.claim: Lion SSD Base is boot volume Bay 1, 999.9GB, erase=NEVER, holds Lion 10.7 installed and booting; moving to optical bay requires Startup Disk bless, do NOT re-bless Bay 4 ESD.
facts.value: Bay1 Lion SSD Base NEVER erase

source.quote: Lion SSD Base | Bay 1 | erase=NEVER

facts.claim: Mac Pro 3,1 logic board spans bottom with dual LGA771 Xeon sockets under large black finned heatsinks horizontal behind GPU, northbridge heatsink, board PCB deep blue rendered outline-only in BW, PCIe slots below.

source.ref: Apple Mac Pro Early 2008 Service Manual + operator photo 2026-09-12 (heatsink visible behind GTX 285)
source.quote: Heatsink covers processors; two processor sockets

facts.claim: Memory compartment is a large silver shroud lower-left housing two FB-DIMM riser cards, each 4 slots (8 total) DIMMs vertical, latches top/bottom, windows lower-right show riser PCBs with caps (outline only in BW).

source.ref: Apple Mac Pro Early 2008 tech specs + photo 2026-09-12 lower-right windows
source.quote: 8 FB-DIMM slots on two memory riser cards

facts.claim: Front fan assembly is a single large blower module covering logic board top edge behind Bay 1; must be lifted 40mm to expose two hidden SATA II ports under Bay 1 (G-03). Not dual small fans.

source.ref: blog.greggant Definitive Guide + photo 2026-09-12 fan strip behind bays
source.quote: fan assembly covering the hidden SATA ports

facts.claim: GTX 285 aux power originates from logic board 6-pin headers (BOARD END IN) and routes to GPU top-edge 6-pin sockets (GPU END OUT). Photo shows both unplugged dangling in loop center-left; correct installed direction is board->GPU.
facts.value: board header -> GPU socket, dangling when unplugged

source.ref: Apple Mac Pro 3,1 PCIe aux power + operator photo 2026-09-12 (cables dangling center-left)
source.quote: PCI Express auxiliary power from logic board to graphics card

facts.claim: EVGA GTX 285 Mac Edition (01G-P3-1080-TR) is a double-wide blower: ~2/3 smooth label shroud + ~1/3 square-framed circular turbine fan; metal I/O bracket with stacked DVI ports is at one short end and MUST sit flush against the rear PCI frame rail when installed; gold PCIe edge along the bottom; two side-by-side 6-pin aux sockets are recessed in the end cap at the FAN end, fed by the factory black booster cable bundle from logic board aux connectors (board end in), never PSU-fed. In case-on-side canon view bracket = rear/right, fan = inboard/left; p8 inverted them and was rejected.
facts.value: bracket flush rear/right, fan inboard/left, 6-pin pair at fan end cap

source.ref: Newegg N82E16814130500 flat product shot + HotHardware EVGA press gallery angled shot + iFixit guide 14161 step 5 booster cable; operator verdict 2026-09-12 p8 'everything is good, excluding the gpu'
source.quote: EVGA GeForce GTX 285 Mac Edition 01G-P3-1080-TR; iFixit step 5 'Card with Booster Cable'

facts.claim: Each HDD blank is an aluminum sled (captive front thumbscrew + small screw right end, rails, rear connector). Leftmost blanks weathered/scratched; sled slides front-to-rear 30mm on rails. PSU is smooth silver top above bays.

source.ref: Apple Mac Pro User Guide bay illustration + operator photo 2026-09-12
source.quote: hard drive sled with captive screw

facts.claim: Operator-verbatim upright open-side layout (2026-09-12): LEFT = front fan tray with TWO ~140mm blower encasings; between fans and RAM = dual CPUs and heatsinks under a metal compartment; right of CPUs = RAM cage; above RAM = GTX 285 backplate/blower with THREE more PCIe slots behind it and a power connector dangling from the case (booster cable); above the GPU blower fan = the four drive bays L-to-R; TOP compartments left-to-right = encased DVD drive (one cd/dvd bay) then the PSU in its own compartment behind/right of the DVD; lower REAR = 140mm exhaust. Rear I/O full detail required in art.
